strings: Experimental Xeon Particle Entropy Reaction Infuser or something like that. Nanotrasen's new reaction infuser, with a slight less tendency to catastrophically fail than the previous model... or so they say.
A glass lab container for storing interesting creatures.
A huge chunk of iron used to separate rooms.
A large piece of space-resistant printed paper.
A flexible, superconducting insulated cable for heavy-duty power transfer.
A one meter section of regular pipe.
Basic railing meant to protect idiots like you from falling.
A control terminal for the area's electrical systems.
Flooring that shows its contents underneath. Engineers love it!
Pull this in case of emergency. Thus, keep pulling it forever.
A square piece of iron standing on four metal legs. It can not move.
A red Nanotrasen issued flare. There are instructions on the side, it reads 'pull cord, make light'.
Come on Lady Luck, spawn me a pair of sunglasses.
A luxurious double bed, for those too important for small dreams.
It is decorated with a crate emblem in silver lining.  It's rather tough, and just the thing to lie on after a hard day of pushing paper.
A console intended to send requests to different departments on the station.
You shouldn't see this. Report it please.
Soft velvet carpeting. Feels good between your toes.
Has a valve and pump attached to it.
A machine that monitors atmosphere levels. Goes off if the area is dangerous.
Contains all the paper you'll never need.
It's a normal black ink pen.
Emergency air-tight shutter, capable of sealing off breached areas. It has a mechanism to open it with just your hands.
It's a floor-mounted device for projecting holographic images.
It's a storage unit for emergency breath masks and O2 tanks.
A little bit of nature contained in a pot.
You sit in this. Either by will or force.
A trash bin, place your trash here for the janitor to collect.
Do not apply fire to this. Rumour says it burns easily.
In Greek myth, Prometheus stole fire from the Gods and gave it to 		humankind. The jewelry he kept for himself.
Now you see me, now you don't...
A reinforced version of the four legged table.
It's an underfloor wiring terminal, used to draw power from the grid.
A large structural assembly made out of metal; It requires a layer of iron before it can be considered a wall.
A conveyor control switch. It appears to only go in one direction.
A huge chunk of reinforced metal used to separate rooms.
A charging dock for energy based weaponry, PDAs, and other devices.
kitty ears or rabbit ears spawner
Used to remotely lockdown linked Cyborgs and Drones.
Contains condensed capsaicin for use in law \"enforcement.\"
A basic handheld radio that communicates with local telecommunication networks.
A canister for the storage of gas.
Emergency air-tight shutter, capable of sealing off breached areas. This one has a glass panel. It has a mechanism to open it with just your hands.
A console used to interface with R&D tools.
A chute that sends people directly to the holding cell. Convenient! If unethical.
A small wall mounted cabinet designed to hold a fire extinguisher.
All engineering related spawners go here
Thin, fragile flooring created with metal foam. Designed to be easily replacable by tiling when applied to in a combat stance.
A catwalk for easier EVA maneuvering and cable placement.
A one meter section of heat-exchanging pipe.
A stationary computer. This one comes preloaded with research programs.
A soft and fluffy pillow. You can smack someone with this!
A table made of titanium reinforced silica-plasma composite. About as durable as it sounds.
A rubbery mat with a inset pattern of white phosphorescent dye.
A tank full of industrial welding fuel. Do not consume.
A huge chunk of metal with a dial embedded in it. Fine print on the dial reads \"Scarborough Arms - 2 tumbler safe, guaranteed thermite resistant, explosion resistant, and assistant resistant.\"
A Simpleton's Guide to Safe-cracking with Stethoscopes
A good-looking sheath that is advertised as being made of real Venusian black leather. It feels rather plastic-like to the touch, and it looks like it's made to fit a British cavalry sabre.
Designed to quickly reload seven-chamber .357 revolvers.
An outdated medical apparatus for listening to the sounds of the human body. It also makes you look like you know what you're doing.
Some rods. Can be used for building or something.
A sink used for washing one's hands and face. Passively reclaims water over time.
An outlet for the pneumatic disposal system.
This device is used to trigger station functions which require more than one ID card to authenticate, or to give the Janitor access to a department.
A set of Nanotrasen regulations for keeping law, order, and procedure followed within their space stations.
A portable item using blue-space technology. One of the buttons opens a portal, the other re-opens your last destination.
A high-capacity superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) unit.
You want it, we got it. Brought to you in partnership with Vlad's Salads.
The POWER that gamers CRAVE! In partnership with Vlad's Salad.
A stationary computer. This one comes preloaded with identification modification programs.
A lightbulb you can walk on without breaking it, amazing.
A trusty station intercom, ready to spring into action even when the headsets go silent.
A pump that moves gas by pressure.
A window that is reinforced with metal rods.
A one meter section of regular pipe used to connect pipenets over pipes.
Heavy duty mechanical shutters with an atmospheric seal that keeps them airtight once closed.
A freestanding medical kiosk, which can provide a wide range of medical analysis for diagnosis.
A machine with a catchy name. It dispenses botany related clothing and gear.
A nasty looking shard of plasma glass.
A lightweight foamed metal wall that can be used as base to construct a wall.
A desk lamp with an adjustable mount.
Different from the Middle Ages version.
This is used to lie in, sleep in or strap on.
You might dream of Nar'Sie if you sleep with this. It seems rather tattered and glows of an eldritch presence.
The air smells strange over this sinister flooring.
Pstttthhh! Pass it under the table.

An industrial unit made to hold, charge, and decontaminate equipment. It comes with a built-in UV cauterization mechanism. A small warning label advises that organic matter should not be placed into the unit.
No matter how much you squirm, it'll still be uncomfortable.
A flimsy framework of iron rods.
It has some unsavory stains on it...
cushioned to protect from rough landings
Mirror mirror on the wall, who's the most robust of them all?
Used to view and edit personnel's security records.
For connecting portables devices related to atmospherics control.
A figurine depicting a Botanist that surely won't let kudzu get out of control.
An interface between crew and the cryogenic storage oversight systems.
A heavy duty blast door that opens mechanically.
A pump for cycling an external airlock controlled by the connected doors.
A machine used to store data and network statistics.
A warning sign which reads 'EXTERNAL AIRLOCK'.
A gate able to perform mid-depth scans on any organisms who pass under it.
Some type of shrubbery. Known for causing considerable economic stress on designers.
You can't tell if this is real grass or just cheap plastic imitation.
Bluespace technologies on the application of bureaucracy.
Woven with advanced nanothread for warmth as well as being very decorated, essential for all officials.
A stationary computer. This one comes preloaded with generic programs.
Perfectly designed to be comfortable to sit on, and hellish to sleep on.
A strange moth plushie named Edict, it's dyed purple.

"The Northstar-class is equipped with an engine waste temperature control system as standard.
To set it up, follow these steps:
1. Wrench in the plasma can.
2. Turn on the waste cooling gas pump and set the thermomachines to the desired temperature (if you're not sure, set them to cold).
3. Set the scrubbers in the chamber to Siphoning in the air alarm.
4. Turn on the filter to the canisters as desired, or replace it.
5. Turn on the Engine Waste to Atmos pump.
6. Inside atmospherics, turn on the Engine Waste to Filter pump, or use the waste however else is desired.
Once everything on that list is complete, make sure the gas isn't building up inside the chamber or pipes and you're done."
values.name: "HOW TO SET UP THE SM WASTE"
